Balanced strip operation: on m sites with K>=1 vacancies choose a vacant pivot uniformly and rotate it to position0. An adjacent empty strip supports original hard legal transpositions; at most m(m-1) instructions. Starting from the UNNORMALIZED Bernoulli measure restricted to nonfull strips, output density is rho_m(eta)=m/K(eta) 1{eta_0=0}. Group elements retain multiplicity even for periodic configurations. E rho_m^2=V_m=m sum_{k=1}^m binom(m,k)q^k p^(m-k)/k, with V1=q and V_m=mp/(m-1)V_(m-1)+1-p^m. The sectorwise endpoint second moment is optimal by Cauchy-Schwarz, not the full current energy. Fresh disjoint strip laws compose up to deterministic coordinate relocation; endpoint moments multiply, with additional intermediate m^2 factor. No short-program-to-low-congestion inference is made.

Conserved-division cylinder current: for empty column A and adjacent nonfull B, superpose all vacant-pivot paths. Source multiplicity K=m-N_total is conserved by every used exchange, so H=F/K has exact divergence 1{A empty,B nonfull}-1{B empty,A nonfull}. Dividing by changing active-front counts is invalid. Cancellation leaves8m-10 vacancy-cylinder terms; intersections yield exact moments and an O(m)-summand sectorwise energy expression. Producer timings for m64/256 are approximately.0034/.052s, recovered from original report because the paste loses the table. They are not portable guarantees or an intake benchmark.

Recursive gate: force port occupied for reservoir-only planning; empty left column/bottom row forms frame. Seed2-square probability lower f2=q^3. For four n-square children, extension r_n=(1-p^(n-1))/(1-p^n) product_{k=n}^{2n-1}(1-p^k)(1-p^(k+1)), f_(2n)=4f_n r_n^2/(r_n+3f_n). Child-good events are disjoint/independent but overlapping growth events are not independent: EX>=r_n S, EX^2<=EX+3S^2/4 supplies Cauchy-Schwarz. For fixed p<1, f_L eventually approaches1; required L and energy are not uniformly practical. At4/5,L4096, producer outward rational f>=.857598203285 and coarse Kcal(1-f)<=81.1958251981 (decimals are directed displays of rational certificates).

Prepare both frames with simulated occupied ports, track port tokens, legally exchange tokens in interior, undo preparations. Same word applies to all four actual port assignments and restores EVERY reservoir occupation; a port token is never used as a known vacancy witness. Ensemble divergence is exactly (sigma_u-sigma_v)g_u g_v. N760's genuinely nonlocal frozen-reservoir lift supplies global conservation and completion tails. N751 exact-local no-go remains intact; this finite module intentionally retains a source defect.

Full energy accounting: for unnormalized positive-source intermediate density rho_t and overlap weights<=4, E sum_b w_b H_b^2<=16T^2 sup_t E rho_t^2. Put R_L=16 product_{k=2}^{L-1}max(1,V_k)max(1,V_(k+1)), S=L^4/16 seed pairs,N=2L^2,T=256L^3. Source derives sup E rho_t^2<=S^2 N^6 L^2(q/p)R_L^2, charging port-position pairs, marked vacant-port forgetting and palindromic return histories. C_L<=8T^2 S^2 N^6 L^2 R_L^2/(p^2 gamma^2). For f<=gamma and1-f<sqrt5-2, D>=p^2 f^2/[8T^2 S^2 N^6 L^2 R_L^2 Kcal(1-f)]. This does not assume a supplied spectral gap, unknown congestion or free history erasure.

The L4096 pair contains33,554,432 sites; conservative T=17,592,186,044,416 instructions, not an executed word. Gate acquisition O(L^2) work/memory; sampled route O(L) macros expands O(L^3). Scalar gate/moment evaluation O(L) updates carries growing arbitrary-precision integer costs. The finite ensemble defines an exact current but affordable general pointwise summation is not proved. No configuration graph was enumerated for that instance. No polynomial accuracy complexity, practical dense-system prediction, dual hierarchy completeness or two-sided convergence follows. Previous ensemble L2 completion tails remain ensemble, not uniform pointwise bounds.

Rare-frame obstruction: positive-mass preparation of mass gamma into F with probability epsilon has E r^2>=gamma^2/epsilon after forgetting history labels. For legal preparation divergence1_G-r and gamma>epsilon, energy>=2(gamma-epsilon)^2/(|E_Q|epsilon). A specified L-frame has probability q^(2L-1); atq=.2,L4096 this is about10^-5725.26 (two frames10^-11450.53). For fixed p,V_m=1/q+O(1/m), giving paired moment scale q^-4L up to polynomial factors. This is limited to positive-density preparation into a specified rare event, not every signed port-exchange current or every compressed certificate. Signed preparation/return cancellation or distributed moving interfaces are open escape routes, neither proved impossible nor constructed here.
